Knicks' Banner Night Spoiled by LeBron James and Sixers

The New York Knicks celebrated raising a championship banner to the rafters of Madison Square Garden, but their opening night was spoiled by LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers, who defeated them. Separately, the NFL is proceeding with a game in Paris, with heightened security measures in place amid civil unrest.
